title: Giovanni [Surname]
text:
PhD student in Economics (EMIS, 39th cycle), University of Ferrara (UNIFE). Supervised by Prof. Leonzio Rizzo, in collaboration with Prof. Francesco Porcelli.


My research sits at the intersection of local government behavior, fiscal federalism, and causal inference, with a focus on:

Intermunicipal cooperation
Property tax compliance (IMU tax gap)
Land use and municipal budget allocation in Italian municipalities
